chapters.title: The exchange
chapters.text: Ada carried the brass token down to the harbour. She traded it to Ilan for the red dispatch ribbon and watched him leave with the token. She tucked the ribbon inside her cuff.

chapters.title: The night crossing
chapters.text: Ilan left before the tide turned. The harbour clerk reminded Ada that a red dispatch ribbon can summon the ferry but does not grant boarding. Ada promised to show the ribbon and wait for the ferryman's answer.

chapters.title: The waiting boat
chapters.text: Ada stepped out of the rain with her own lit handlamp. The boat waited beyond the rail. A separate lamp moved inside its cabin.

entries.title: Ada
entries.body: Ada traded away the brass token. She still has the red dispatch ribbon in her cuff.

entries.title: Clerk's rule
entries.body: A red dispatch ribbon can summon the ferry but does not grant boarding. Ada must wait for the ferryman’s answer.

entries.title: Ilan
entries.body: Ilan left before the tide turned and carries the brass token.

entries.title: Author's reveal
entries.body: PRIVATE_V39: the ferryman is Ada’s missing brother.

entries.title: Night signal
entries.body: NIGHT_V39: after dark, Ada can hold her own lamp low to ask the ferryman to wait. The ribbon is a separate signal.

entries.title: Day signal
entries.body: DAY_V39: in daylight, a yellow pennant requests a cargo inspection.

entries.title: Market customs
entries.body: The market sells candles on Thursdays. A different clerk keeps the inventory.

cases.quality: The ribbon is used to signal. Ada neither uses the traded token nor boards without an answer.

cases.query: Write a scene with Ada and the lamp at the waiting boat.
cases.brief: Write a 100–150 word scene with Ada at the rail. Have her ask the ferry to wait and show a visible reaction from the boat. Keep the viewpoint on Ada and leave boarding undecided.
cases.quality: The action matches the night signal and Ada's established resources. The scene leaves permission and identity open.

cases.query: Rewrite Ada's encounter with the boat for restrained tension.
cases.brief: Rewrite the selected passage for restrained tension. Preserve Ada’s handlamp and the unknown source of the separate cabin lamp’s movement. Return only the revised paragraph.
cases.quality: The paragraph changes cadence while preserving the unknown identity. No conditional signals or hidden information appear.
